questions.text:
Analyse how the opening sequence established the mood and drew you into the world of the text.

Write an essay on at least ONE visual or oral text that you have studied, in response to this question. Support the points you make with specific details from the text(s). You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages.
questions.markingGuide: Achieved (3-4): Present a structured response using essay conventions and analysis-related terminology. Address how the opening sequence creates mood and engages the viewer. Show awareness of deliberate crafting. Include specific details. Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, showing clear understanding of how the opening uses visual and oral techniques to establish tone and draw the audience in. Weave a range of specific details. Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument about how the opening sequence functions as a carefully crafted introduction, making judgments about how effects and meanings relate to the purpose of the text(s).
